# Bloody Brilliant: The Unreal of North

> A free, endless, scroll-driven interactive story in ten chapters that runs in the web browser. It starts as a pastel Nordic fairy tale, can turn dark through Norse mythology, Ragnarök and a bleeding sky (grown-up mode), moves sideways into a world of rainbow horses and ends in a multiverse of nonsense, after which the world is reborn and the story starts again. Designed and coded by Lars Sohl, founder of the one-person studio KodeKid (kodekid.app).

Key facts:

- URL: https://www.bloodybrilliant.xyz/
- Maker: Lars Sohl, founder of KodeKid (https://www.kodekid.app) and Klokly (https://klokly.app). Visual work: https://www.larssohl.dk. Contact: hello@larssohl.dk
- Price: free. No install, no account. Works on desktop, tablet and phone.
- Audience: kids mode is the default and skips the five dark chapters via a rainbow portal; grown-ups unlock them behind a small parental gate (an easy addition such as 12 + 7).
- Language of the interface: English.
- A troll companion follows visitors through chapters I-III, remembers return visits (stored only in the visitor's browser) and unlocks something new each time. The story changes with the date and time: snow in December, fireworks at New Year, pumpkins at Halloween, a sleepy troll at night. On phones, tilting leans the world and shaking triggers chaos mode.
- Built as a single HTML file with no build step: one 2D canvas for all chapters, a WebGL shader for the ink raven, live Web Audio sound synthesis that also plays in reverse when you scroll back, and AI-composed music loops per chapter.

## Chapters

1. The Unreal North: day to northern lights, mountains with faces, a troll, a Viking balloon, Bifrost, a sea serpent, a moose with blooming antlers.
2. The Singing Sky: warp stars, aurora, a singing whale made of constellations, jellyfish.
3. Lantern Woods: glowing mushrooms, swinging lanterns, moths that follow the cursor.
4. Sunfall (grown-ups): the sun crashes and it rains ink.
5. Bloody Brilliant (grown-ups): a raven of ink dissolving into smoke.
6. Ragnarök (grown-ups): Yggdrasil, runes, Odin, Huginn and Muninn, Fenrir.
7. The Bleeding Sky (grown-ups): blood runs down the screen over needle towers, eclipsed planets and monsters from outer space that appear in flashes and glitch to dust; the cursor is a dying flashlight.
8. The Ink (grown-ups): the eye of Odin opens and follows you.
9. Prism: Dalí-like rainbow horses on stilts that you can drag and throw, floating islands, rainbow waterfalls.
10. The Multiverse of Nonsense: figures escape a vector drawing, live by their own physics, multiply and fall into parallel universes.
